title: The completion along a finitely generated ideal is complete with the same quotient
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ a finitely generated ideal and $A^\wedge$ the $I$-adic completion of $A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with $\pi^\wedge:A^\wedge\to A/I$, $(x_n)_n\mapsto x_1$. Then (1) $A^\wedge$ is $IA^\wedge$-adically complete; (2) $\pi^\wedge$ is surjective with kernel $IA^\wedge$, and its composite with $A\to A^\wedge$ is the quotient map $A\to A/I$; hence $\pi^\wedge$ induces an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $A^\wedge/IA^\wedge\cong A/I$.
